Probably loaned from a different Italic language such as Oscan, where the word could have referred to any creeping small animal such as a hamster. The connection with Proto-Slavic *žaba (“toad”) is uncertain, as the initial vowel cannot reflect a common Indo-European origin. Usually connected with Latin bōs, bovis (“cow”), reflecting an ancient folk belief that toads — among other animals — were thought to steal milk from livestock.
